finding.title: Existing resume writer bypasses the new RCAP draft capability
finding.mechanism: save-resume accepts a requester-supplied existing sessionId with answers and email without authenticating the draft capability. Its storage upserts answers then installs the requester email/resume token. New automatic PUT saves retain those resume fields, so a requester who knows a victim URL session UUID can arrange a token capable of returning later automatically saved victim answers. Existing rate limits do not establish session authority.
finding.classification: Existing write authorization weakness becomes relevant to new automatic sensitive-answer persistence; new endpoint isolation alone is insufficient. Source-derived exploit path, not executed.
finding.smallest_repair: Authorize writes to existing RCAP sessions in save-resume with the same signed draft capability/live scope and appropriate same-origin boundary; preserve unrelated DTC and verified resume paths. Add focused negative coverage for a foreign/no-cookie save-resume request before accepting boundary.
